claimWinnings(uint256).details: Claim winnings from a resolved market.       Calls MeridianMarket.claim() which transfers collateral back to the vault.

deployCapital(uint256,bool,uint256).details: Deploy capital from the vault into a prediction market by buying shares.      The vault approves and calls MeridianMarket.buy() directly.

params.isYes: true = buy YES, false = buy NO

depositToUsyc(uint256).details: Deposit idle USDC into USYC via Teller for yield

params.amount: Amount of USDC to deposit (6 decimals)

getAvailableCapital().details: Get available USDC capital (not deployed, not in USYC)

getCalibrationScore().details: Get the agent's calibration score (win rate as basis points)

getNetPnL().details: Get the net P&L of the vault

getUsycBalance().details: Get USYC balance (idle capital earning yield)

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

redeemFromUsyc(uint256).details: Redeem USYC back to USDC via Teller (to deploy into markets)

params.amount: Amount of USYC to redeem (6 decimals)

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.
